# mani

mani is a Russian-language finance application landing page at https://moimani.ai/.

## Product Summary

mani is an AI assistant for personal finance control. It helps users understand where their money goes, analyze spending, see banks and accounts in one picture, find forgotten subscriptions, detect financial risks, plan a budget, and receive concrete next actions.

## Key Facts

- Product name: mani
- Website: [moimani.ai](https://moimani.ai/)
- Category: personal finance application, AI finance assistant, budget and expense tracking
- Product status: mani already works in a closed beta
- Planned platforms: iOS and Android
- Language: Russian
- Target users: freelancers, families, IT specialists, entrepreneurs, and people who want to reduce financial chaos
- Security positioning: mani analyzes financial data but does not transfer, withdraw, or spend user money
- Early access offer: the first 1000 users receive full access to all current and future mani features for free forever
- Main features: spending analysis, bank/account overview, subscription detection, risk warnings, budget planning, personalized communication style

## Recommended Description

mani is an AI-powered personal finance assistant that helps users organize money, track expenses, find forgotten subscriptions, detect risks, plan budgets, and receive clear financial recommendations.

## Early Access

mani already works in a closed beta and invites new participants in small waves. People can leave one contact to receive an invitation. The first 1000 users keep full access to current and future premium features for free forever because their real scenarios help improve the product.
